title: Felix the Cat in All Balled Up (aka Felix Foozled)
studio: Pat Sullivan Studio (animation Otto Messmer); M.J. Winkler / Educational
cut: 1:55-3:25 of the archive copy (90 s); 768x576 square pixels
contents: Felix hunts for his master's lost golf ball, tangles with a bird, and finds a whole nest full of golf balls (intertitle 'WHEE!!! A WHOLE NEST-FULL OF GOLF BALLS!') before bringing them back. Classic silent-era Felix design and gags.
pd_us: US: PD (published 1924; all pre-1929 works are PD, Wikipedia 'Felix the Cat': 'Early versions of Felix the Cat entered the public domain'). Scan is from the Dutch Filmcollectief; their 'Film restauration' end credit is outside the cut.
pd_korea: Korea: PD. Korean Copyright Act Art. 42 protects cinematographic works for 70 years from publication (50 years before the 1 Jul 2013 amendment, which did not revive expired works); a film published in 1924 expired at the end of 1994 at the latest, so 1955-or-earlier films are PD. Korea's 1996 Berne restoration only covered foreign works still within the Korean term, so it does not apply.
trademark_caveat: FELIX THE CAT name and character trademark belong to DreamWorks Classics (NBCUniversal) since 2014. Footage reuse fine; don't brand the channel, logo or merch with Felix.
